batchMessage: One tank. One nutrient batch. Adjust at the next refill.
stageMessage: Start light for seeds, increase for active growth, and use the production blend when fruiting crops begin producing.
mixingOrder: Confirm the reservoir is reasonably clean and free of significant debris.
Fill the IBC with approximately 275 gallons of water.
Add magnesium sulfate and allow it to dissolve.
Add calcium nitrate separately after the other ingredients are dissolved.
Continue running the mixing pump until the solution is evenly blended.
Verify pump operation and proper tower flow.
Begin the normal automated feed schedule.

seeds.label: Seeds and very young seedlings
seeds.description: HydroPip's light starting mixture provides young plants with nutrients without beginning with an unnecessarily heavy concentration.

growing.label: Established sprouts and vegetative growth
growing.description: HydroPip's normal growing mixture increases nutrient availability as established plants grow and nutrient demand rises.
useWhen: Leafy greens and herbs are actively growing
The garden is in vegetative growth

fruiting.label: Heavy growth, flowering, and fruit production
fruiting.description: HydroPip's heavier production mixture supports mature plants and fruiting crops with higher nutrient demand.
useWhen: Fruit or vegetables are actively forming
Large mature plants are consuming heavily
The system contains many fruiting plants

normalOperation: Fill the IBC to approximately 275 gallons and mix one complete batch for the plants' current stage.
Allow the system to gradually consume the solution over approximately one month.
Do not routinely refill the tank to keep it full or add another full nutrient dose during the same batch.
Monitor pH, plant appearance, water level, pump operation, and tower flow. EC is an optional optimization for basic HydroPip operation.
If the level becomes too low for safe pump operation, add only enough plain water to protect the pump; this is an exception, not the normal method.
When the tank is nearly empty, inspect it, refill with fresh water, and create a new batch selected by actual plant development.
endOfBatch: Inspect the reservoir and remove visible sediment or debris.
Inspect and clean pump intakes or filters if needed.
Inspect the tower feed hose and the separate mixing-pump circulation hose.
Refill the IBC with fresh water.
Review the plants' current growth stage and select the next recipe.
Mix a completely fresh batch and restart the normal mixing and feed schedule.

mixingPump.plainLanguage: Connect a hose to the internal mixing pump and run it up to the IBC's top opening. Loop the hose near the opening and point the outlet back down into the tank. Use a bungee, rope, or reusable strap connected to the molded loops beside the opening to hold the hose in place. Water discharged from the hose should create strong circulation without splashing outside the tank.
steps: Place the internal mixing pump near the bottom of the IBC.
Attach correctly sized flexible hose to the pump outlet.
Run the hose upward to the large access opening at the top of the IBC.
Loop the hose near the opening and point the outlet back down into the reservoir.
Secure the hose to the molded loops beside the opening with a small bungee, rope, or reusable strap.
Aim the top discharge so it creates visible circulation through the tank without splashing outside.
Keep the assembly removable; no drilling or permanent IBC wall plumbing is required.
why: Pulls solution from low in the IBC and discharges it near the top
Provides visible proof that the mixing pump is running
Remains easy to remove and clean

weakCirculation: Inspect the hose for kinks or collapse
Confirm the intake is clear and the pump is submerged
Clean the prefilter or intake screen
Match hose diameter to the pump outlet
Confirm adequate pump flow for the lift height
hoseFalls: Reattach it to the molded loops beside the top opening
Use a shorter bungee or tighter strap
Keep the outlet directed safely downward
splashing: Lower it slightly inside the opening
Keep the outlet inside the reservoir opening
localizedMovement: Reposition the outlet for broader circulation
Aim diagonally downward instead of at the nearest wall
Keep the discharge near the top rather than beside the pump
Inspect the hose and pump for restricted flow

suggestedReminders: Check tank level and pump intake.
Confirm the mixing-pump hose is secure.
Inspect circulation at the mixing pump's top-discharge hose.
Review plant growth before the next nutrient batch.
Your reservoir may be approaching refill time.
Choose the next nutrient strength based on current plant development.
Inspect pumps, filters, and hoses before refilling.
safetyNote: Measure nutrients accurately, store them securely, and handle each product according to its label. Never premix concentrated MasterBlend and calcium nitrate together in the same small container.
